title: TransMorph
paper_title: TransMorph: Transformer for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration
core_mech: TransMorph 用层级 Swin encoder 取代纯 CNN 配准编码器，同时保留 U-Net 式 decoder 和可微 warping。
core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional encoder in VoxelMorph with a 3D hierarchical Swin Transformer encoder while retaining a convolutional U-Net decoder and Spatial Transformer warping.
input_desc: moving 图像 Im 与 fixed 图像 If
input_en: Concatenated 3D moving and fixed volumes (I_m, I_f)
output_desc: 稠密位移场 φ、warped moving 图像及可选不确定性估计
output_en: Dense 3D displacement field φ, warped moving image I_m ∘ φ, and optional Bayesian uncertainty

adapter.name: TransMorph
adapter.mechanism: Original four-level 3D Swin hierarchy, convolutional decoder, transformer/convolution skips and voxel-unit SpatialTransformer, trained with original MSE plus Grad3d loss.
limitations: 32-cubed resampled synthetic volumes; embedding width8, two blocks per level, 2-cubed windows and no stochastic depth; both directions accumulated into one optimizer step. Raw flow components are D/H/W voxel displacements; normalized_xyz_flow converts them explicitly.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
